facts.statement: Zeltornis is an extinct genus of bird.
The only known species in the genus is Zeltornis ginsburgi.
The genus Zeltornis was described by Balouet in 1981.
Zeltornis lived during the Early Miocene epoch.
Zeltornis is an extinct genus of heron.
facts.quote: Zeltornis ("Zelten bird") is an extinct genus of heron.

facts.statement: The estimated wingspan of Zeltornis is 2.50 meters.
facts.quote: Its wingspan is estimated at 2.50 m (8 ft 4 in).

facts.statement: Zeltornis is known from a single right coracoid bone with the distal part missing.
facts.quote: It is known from a single right coracoid of which the distal part is missing (MNHN collection, uncatalogued).

facts.statement: Zeltornis is believed to be most closely allied to night herons.
facts.quote: In particular it seems to have been allied most closely to the night herons

facts.statement: Zeltornis belongs to the family Ardeidae.

rejected.statement: Zeltornis resembled modern night herons but was much larger, standing 2 meters tall and weighing about 15 kilograms.
rejected.quote: Zeltornis probably resembled the modern night herons, but was much larger, standing 2 m (6 ft 8 in) tall and weighing about 15 kg.
